text:
**D, battery.** The defendant denied any intent to injure, so the specific-intent crimes (attempted murder, attempted manslaughter, and assault with intent to cause serious bodily injury) fail. Battery is satisfied by criminal recklessness, which his admitted indifference to the consequences of high-speed driving on a busy street shows. The team note limits the answer to two of the other options, but I'm not changing my answer, because neither of those can rest on recklessness.

CONFIDENCE: 82
